name_zh: 伊姆兰汗：体育名流入政/慈善国家/反腐民粹/不信任投票/军政博弈
name_en: Imran Khan: Sports Star Turned Politician/Charity State/Anti-Corruption Populism/No-Confidence Vote/Military-Political Game
description_zh: 伊姆兰汗是巴基斯坦的著名板球运动员，2007-2022年，他从体育明星转型为政治家，领导巴基斯坦实施了多项改革。他推行了反腐运动，赢得了广泛支持。他在2022年面临不信任投票，但成功保住了权力。他执政期间，巴基斯坦的体育和政治关系得到了加强。他领导巴基斯坦在国际事务中发挥了重要作用。
description_en: Imran Khan was a famous Pakistani cricket player from 2007 to 2022, who transitioned from sports star to politician, leading Pakistan to implement multiple reforms. He implemented an anti-corruption movement and won widespread support. In 2022, he faced a no-confidence vote but successfully retained power. During his tenure, the relationship between sports and politics in Pakistan was strengthened. He led Pakistan to play an important role in international affairs.
reason_zh: 伊姆兰汗从体育明星转型为政治家，但他的反腐运动引发了国内反对。他的执政期间，巴基斯坦的政治和经济关系得到了加强。他的领导艺术得到了广泛认可，但他的政治生涯充满争议。他的执政结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
reason_en: Imran Khan transitioned from sports star to politician but faced domestic opposition to his anti-corruption movement. During his tenure, the relationship between sports and politics in Pakistan was strengthened, and his leadership art was widely recognized. However, his political career was full of controversy. After his tenure ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
steps_zh: 学习伊姆兰汗的领导艺术和政治动员能力，理解在现代社会中推动改革的必要性
研究巴基斯坦的反腐运动和政治改革，掌握在专制环境下推行改革的方法
分析伊姆兰汗的不信任投票和政治生存能力，掌握政治风险管理
探讨伊姆兰汗的体育明星转型，理解体育和政治关系的复杂性
总结伊姆兰汗的经验教训，阐述在现代社会中推行改革的风险和挑战
steps_en: Study Imran Khan's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, understand the necessity of promoting reforms in modern society
Study Pakistan's anti-corruption movement and political reforms, master methods for推行改革 in authoritarian environments
Analyze Imran Khan's no-confidence vote and political survival abilities, master political risk management
Explore Imran Khan's sports star transition, understand the complexity of sports and political relationships
Summarize Imran Khan's experiences and the challenges of implementing reforms in modern society
expected_zh: 掌握伊姆兰汗的领导艺术和政治动员能力，熟悉巴基斯坦的反腐运动和政治改革，理解政治生存和风险管理，分析体育明星转型和政治关系，培养学生对在现代社会中推行改革的理解和认识。
expected_en: Master Imran Khan's leadership art and political mobilization abilities, be familiar with Pakistan's anti-corruption movement and political reforms, understand political survival and risk management, analyze sports star transition and political relationships, cultivate students' understanding and awareness of implementing reforms in modern society.
case_zh: 2022年，伊姆兰汗领导巴基斯坦实施了反腐运动，赢得了广泛支持。他在2022年面临不信任投票，但成功保住了权力。他的领导艺术得到了广泛认可，但他的政治生涯充满争议。他的执政结束后，巴基斯坦陷入了政治动荡。
case_en: In 2022, Imran Khan led Pakistan to implement an anti-corruption movement and win widespread support. He faced a no-confidence vote in 2022 but successfully retained power. His leadership art was widely recognized, but his political career was full of controversy. After his tenure ended, Pakistan descended into political turmoil.
cross_cultural_impact: Anti-corruption movement, sports star turned politician, Pakistani political transformation
